policies.title: Hungarian ordinary passports: Panama short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Hungary's current consular guidance allows Hungarian nationals to enter Panama visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days.
conditions: Ordinary Hungarian passport holder, tourism for up to 90 days, with a return ticket and stated funds.
Residence, work, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Hungarian ordinary passports: Tunisia short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Hungary's current embassy guidance allows Hungarian nationals with a valid passport to stay in Tunisia visa-free for up to 90 days.
conditions: Ordinary Hungarian passport holder, short stay of up to 90 days.
Work, residence, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Hungarian ordinary passports: Ukraine tourist visa exemption
policies.summary: Hungary's current consular guidance allows Hungarian citizens a visa-free Ukrainian tourist stay of up to 90 days in 180 days.
conditions: Ordinary Hungarian passport holder, tourist stay up to 90 days in the first 180 days after entry.
The current travel warning, dual-Ukrainian-national rules, residence, work, special passports and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Hungarian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa issued at arrival
policies.summary: Hungary's current consular guidance expressly permits Hungarian travellers to obtain a single-entry Jordan tourist visa at the Amman or Aqaba airports and most land or sea border crossings.
conditions: Ordinary Hungarian passport holder; single-entry tourist visa issued at a listed airport or border crossing for a 30-day stay.
The separate online application and Jordan Pass payment route do not displace the arrival-issuance route.

policies.title: Hungarian ordinary passports: Bangladesh tourist visa issued at arrival
policies.summary: Hungary's current consular guidance permits Hungarian tourists to obtain a Bangladesh visa on arrival for stays not exceeding 30 days.
conditions: Ordinary Hungarian passport holder, tourism only, stay no longer than 30 days; Bangladesh authorities can refuse the visa at arrival.
The separate electronic application and other travel-purpose routes do not displace this arrival-issuance route.

policies.title: Hungarian ordinary passports: Iran advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Hungary's current consular guidance requires Hungarian citizens to obtain Iran's visa through the embassy process; the online application is not by itself an electronically issued visitor visa.
conditions: Complete Iran's pre-travel embassy visa process, which requires personal participation; an online submission and tracking service alone is not the issued visa.
Iranian dual-national treatment, work, residence, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback labels Iran visa on arrival, but Hungary's current consular guidance requires an embassy visa process with personal participation; its online form is not evidence of electronic visa issuance.
